name: 007-complete-invoice-authoring
statements: ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN party_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'company' CHECK(party_type IN('company','individual'))
UPDATE customers SET party_type='individual' WHERE tax_identifier=''
ALTER TABLE issued_invoices ADD COLUMN customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'company' CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual'))
UPDATE issued_invoices SET customer_party_type='individual' WHERE customer_tax_identifier=''
DROP TRIGGER correction_documents_no_update
ALTER TABLE correction_documents ADD COLUMN customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'company' CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual'))
UPDATE correction_documents SET customer_party_type='individual' WHERE customer_tax_identifier=''
CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON correction_documents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction documents are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE invoice_drafts_new(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,customer_id TEXT,customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,series TEXT NOT NULL,issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('draft','issued')),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,customer_id)REFERENCES customers(organization_id,id))STRICT

INSERT INTO invoice_drafts_new(id,organization_id,customer_id,customer_party_type,customer_legal_name,customer_tax_identifier,customer_country_code,customer_city,customer_street,customer_county,customer_postal_code,series,issue_date,due_date,currency,status) SELECT d.id,d.organization_id,d.customer_id,c.party_type,c.legal_name,c.tax_identifier,c.country_code,c.city,c.street,c.county,c.postal_code,d.series,d.issue_date,d.due_date,d.currency,d.status FROM invoice_drafts d JOIN customers c ON c.organization_id=d.organization_id AND c.id=d.customer_id
DROP TABLE invoice_drafts
ALTER TABLE invoice_drafts_new RENAME TO invoice_drafts
CREATE INDEX drafts_organization_status ON invoice_drafts(organization_id,status)
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.status='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued drafts are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.status='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued drafts are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_insert BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_series WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND document_type='invoice' AND series=NEW.series)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice document series is not configured');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_update BEFORE UPDATE OF organization_id,series ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.series IS NOT NEW.series BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice draft series is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_lines_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_tax_breakdown_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued tax breakdown is immutable');END
DROP TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_update

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON issued_invoices WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.draft_id IS NOT NEW.draft_id OR OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.fiscal_year IS NOT NEW.fiscal_year OR OLD.document_type IS NOT NEW.document_type OR OLD.series IS NOT NEW.series OR OLD.number IS NOT NEW.number OR OLD.issue_date IS NOT NEW.issue_date OR OLD.due_date IS NOT NEW.due_date OR OLD.issued_at IS NOT NEW.issued_at OR OLD.currency IS NOT NEW.currency OR OLD.issuer_legal_name IS NOT NEW.issuer_legal_name OR OLD.issuer_tax_identifier IS NOT NEW.issuer_tax_identifier OR OLD.issuer_country_code IS NOT NEW.issuer_country_code OR OLD.issuer_city IS NOT NEW.issuer_city OR OLD.issuer_street IS NOT NEW.issuer_street OR OLD.issuer_county IS NOT NEW.issuer_county OR OLD.issuer_postal_code IS NOT NEW.issuer_postal_code OR OLD.customer_party_type IS NOT NEW.customer_party_type OR OLD.customer_legal_name IS NOT NEW.customer_legal_name OR OLD.customer_tax_identifier IS NOT NEW.customer_tax_identifier OR OLD.customer_country_code IS NOT NEW.customer_country_code OR OLD.customer_city IS NOT NEW.customer_city OR OLD.customer_street IS NOT NEW.customer_street OR OLD.customer_county IS NOT NEW.customer_county OR OLD.customer_postal_code IS NOT NEW.customer_postal_code OR OLD.total_excluding_tax IS NOT NEW.total_excluding_tax OR OLD.tax_total IS NOT NEW.tax_total OR OLD.total_including_tax IS NOT NEW.total_including_tax BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable except e_factura_status');END
